description: This file contains a Spring Security configuration class that customizes security settings to allow access to the root and h2-console endpoints, as well as disables CSRF protection and frame options to enable h2-console access.

classes.name: SecurityConfig
classes.description: A Spring configuration class that extends WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter to customize web security settings, particularly to permit access to the root URL and h2-console, and disable certain security headers.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the configure method to set up security rules, permitting access to '/' and '/h2-console/**' and disabling CSRF protection and frame options.
